notes.content:

notes.title: Content and features update
notes.content:
Lot of improvement in this update! 
[list]
[*] New gameplay on levels (Temple, Base, volcano)
[*] Fighting crabüls are less easy,
[*] Fixed issues when you restart level, 
[*] Fixed linear rotation issues,
[*] Fixed the dialog bug (mouth movement and sound)
[*] Ability to delete all gameplay datas from the start menu > options
[*] ... and some minors corrections
[/list]
We hope you'll enjoy !

notes.title: NARGUL Playtest - 02/04/2022
notes.content:
[h1]Dates and registrations[/h1]
The NARGUL - Humans Are Among Use playtest will take place on [b]2 and 3 April 2022[/b].
To participate: register on the game page [u][b]before March 31, 2022[/b][/u].
[h1]Conditions of participation[/h1]
[h2]Player[/h2]
To participate, players agree to [b]answer a form[/b] [b]before April 5[/b] to help us finalize the game (and we thank them for that!).
[h2]Requirements[/h2]
NARGUL - Humans Are Among Us being a PC-VR game, the user must be equipped with a configuration suitable for VR on [b]Oculus (link), Vive or index[/b].([url=https: //store.steampowered.com/app/1646810/NARGUL__Humans_are_among_us]see store page for more details[/url])
[h2]Get the full game for free![/h2]
In return for this form, players will receive [b]FREE[/b] the full version of the game, the day of the official release to thank them for their precious help!
